email_draft.subject: Greenfield's SPED vendor search, scoped early | Journify
email_draft.body:
Your board moved to explore SPED case-management vendors in April, and the business office is fielding early inquiries. That timing puts Greenfield ahead of most districts in your enrollment band, and it means there's still room to shape what the evaluation looks like.

With roughly 434 students on IEPs, your case managers and related-service providers are carrying real documentation weight, often without a dedicated tool built for that work. Most teams at this scale find that progress tracking and IEP paperwork eat the hours that should go to students. Journify sits on top of your existing IEP system and gives the whole SPED team, teachers, paraprofessionals, and therapists, a shared workspace where IEP materials generate in under five minutes and every output stays in the educator's hands for review before it's used.

Open to a 20-minute walk-through this week so you can see what a scoped pilot would look like before the board's evaluation moves further along?
email_draft.hook_summary: Board-level informal vendor exploration signal (April 2026) with no incumbent locked in — early buying cycle at Greenfield Township.
